text:
tasha (PM): hey all  sharing a new suggestion for the Alerting SLO config UI. focus areas: 1) make notification preview compact, 2) clarify 'silence' UX (users confused by 'suppression'), 3) ensure keyboard-first flow for channel expansion. figma: https://figma.redwood/alerts/compact-v2
omid (Design): nice. proposing a horizontal 'recipients strip' that shows two avatars + a small "+N" chip. clicking or keyboard-activating +N opens an overlay (positioned absolute) with per-destination actions (simulate delivery, mute destination). overlay should not cause layout shifts.
raj (Frontend): technical notes: render avatars as inline svgs with initials fallback, then progressively replace with fetched images. debounce preview updates by 350ms. lazy-mount overlay DOM on first open to reduce initial footprint.
tasha (PM): for language, product prefers "Silences" but also wants to test "Mute window" as an alternative in user tests. we should show helper text: "Silences stop notifications but keep the incident in history for auditing." short and clear.
omid (Design): UI copy proposal: label the toggle "Silence notifications"; helper copy underneath: "Silences pause outgoing alerts; incidents remain visible for audit." also add inline tooltip on first use: "What's a silence?" linking to docs.
claire (A11y): a11y checklist: 1) +N trigger must be a real button with aria-expanded and aria-controls; 2) overlay should use role=menu since each item has actions; 3) implement roving tabindex for keyboard arrow navigation; 4) toast/undo must be keyboard-focusable and announced. ensure color contrast >= 4.5:1 for chips.
raj (Frontend): implementing overlay as role=menu makes sense. we'll support arrow keys and Enter to open per-item actions. ESC returns focus to +N and closes overlay. for aria-live we can update a polite region with "Preview: sends to 2 channels." to avoid SR spam we will only update on debounce.
omid (Design): for channel clipping, visual idea: first two pills + a slim "+N" pill that shows count. hover or keyboard open reveals full list. design also wants a small 'simulate' CTA in the preview header that opens a modal showing the exact payload for recipients.
raj (Frontend): sample simulate payload for the modal (for design and QA):
```
{
  "alert": "AL-7782",
  "severity": "warning",
  "threshold": "p95>800ms",
  "recipients": ["#model-ops", "pager:team-ml"],
  "note": "Spike in tokenization latency"
}
```
omid (Design): nice. UX tweak: when a user edits a preset threshold it should show a subtle "custom" badge next to the preset and an inline undo link: "Using custom value — Undo" that is keyboard-focusable for 6s. keeps users from being surprised.
claire (A11y): keyboard flow for presets: Tab to the preset group, arrow keys to move selection, Enter to pick. If user switches to Custom, programmatically move focus into the numeric input and announce via aria-live: "Editing custom threshold." the undo element must be reachable by keyboard and labelled "Undo threshold edit".
tasha (PM): backend contract note: product wants to persist both preset id and explicit override so downstream tooling knows the source. propose API fields: `preset_id` (string|null) and `threshold_override` (string|null). raj can you confirm?
raj (Frontend): yep. we'll send both fields. suggested payload shape for API team:
```
{
  "preset_id": "warn_v1",
  "threshold_override": "p95>0.8s"
}
```
omid (Design): one more accessibility detail: the +N pill should have accessible label like "Show 3 more channels" and when expanded the control should be announced as "Channel list expanded, 5 items". use aria-live for that announcement.
claire (A11y): also test with VoiceOver and NVDA. ensure focus rings are high-contrast and visible when user has high-contrast settings or prefers-reduced-motion. toast should not auto-dismiss for keyboard users; timeouts are fine but must be dismissible and focusable.
ux-bot: visual diff ready: https://images.redwood/diff/1782054321-01.png :sparkles:
tasha (PM): perf note: timeline/incident history preview is expensive server-side. for initial release let's use a static illustrative timeline with a small muted label "Live timeline (alpha)" and iterate later after infra work.
omid (Design): I'll update the figma with the +N overlay behaviour, the inline undo text, and the helper copy for silences. will tag @ux-bot when pushed for a diff.
raj (Frontend): I'll stub the overlay and simulate modal in a PR so the design review can click through. I'll also coordinate with api team re: `preset_id` + `threshold_override`.
claire (A11y): I'll run a keyboard + screenreader pass once the PR is up. quick reminder: test announce changes on overlay open and preset-to-custom transitions.
tasha (PM): final checklist before design review Friday:
- [ ] recipients strip + +N overlay (omid + raj)
- [ ] simulate modal + sample payload (raj)
- [ ] rename + helper copy for silences (omid)
- [ ] preset/custom UX + inline undo (omid + raj)
- [ ] aria semantics, focus, contrast checks (claire)
- [ ] static timeline + live badge (raj)

omid (Design): copying checklist to figma comments and will push updates by EOD. ping here for any blockers. :thumbsup:
